open_points.subject: answer_request response id for size or token failures
open_points.text: The body is one JSON-RPC 2.0 message, read only after the size and token checks.
open_points.other_text: The id of every response is the body's id member when the body is one JSON object whose id is a string or an integer, and null otherwise; reading it checks nothing and decides nothing.
open_points.question: For a size or token failure, must the body remain unread, or must it be parsed to preserve a valid string or integer id?

open_points.subject: answer_request handling of internal_error after an operation is reached
open_points.text: MUST call the handler of the named operation, whose name is handle_ followed by the operation name — exactly one of handle_accept_binding, handle_activate_flow_version, handle_add_trial_case, handle_cancel_run, handle_capture_failed_execution, handle_compose_flow_version, handle_decide_effect_approval, handle_get_binding, handle_get_contract_version, handle_get_flow, handle_get_flow_version, handle_get_implementation, handle_get_repair_view, handle_get_run, handle_get_slot, handle_grant_standing_approval, handle_issue_contract_version, handle_list_records, handle_propose_binding, handle_prove_flow_version, handle_read_fixture_file, handle_read_spooled_file, handle_release_run, handle_resolve_unknown_outcome, handle_resume_run, handle_revoke_standing_approval, handle_roll_back_slot, handle_start_run, handle_submit_implementation and handle_try_implementation — with the Actor and the validated request, encode its answer as the tool result — values as JSON text, file bytes as base64 — and turn any exception the handler raises into a refusal answer through translate_failure, except any failure translate_failure answers internal_error — StopRequiredError, StoreInternalError or any unexpected exception, whatever the handler — which it lets propagate to serve_kernel unchanged, since a store change may already be written and only the next start derives every run again.
open_points.other_text: A tools/call that reached its operation returns the result {content: [{type: "text", text: T}], isError: B}: T is the answer of the operation as JSON text and B false, or T is the RefusalAnswer as the JSON object {code, reason} and B true for every refusal decided once the operation is known — fit, bounds, canonical form, permission, or translate_failure of an exception the handler raised; every refusal code is a member of = models.RefusalCode.
open_points.question: When a reached handler raises an exception that translate_failure maps to internal_error, must answer_request propagate it or return it as an isError tool result?
